name: All My Homies Hate
look: A sepia-toned photo of six young men in puffer jackets, hoodies and beanies, one in a ski mask, posing together on the sidewalk outside a store with shelves of bottles, several of them making hand signs at the camera.
use: Rallies the whole crew against one thing. The top caption bluntly rejects something, usually with a curse, and the bottom says 'All my homies hate' it. Remixes add 'All my homies love' for a favored alternative.
slots: top caption: the thing being rejected
bottom caption: 'All my homies hate...' the same thing
examples: All my homies hate group projects
All my homies hate the 8 am meeting
describe: group of guys in winter jackets posing outside a liquor store
six friends in hoodies and beanies standing together on the sidewalk
crew of dudes in puffer coats making hand signs
sepia photo of a squad of friends in front of a shop
group photo of friends who all hate the same thing
